title: Tapscript threshold

schema.script: (<key> CHECKSIGVERIFY)* <key> CHECKSIG (<key> CHECKSIGADD)+ then an optional k and GREATERTHANOREQUAL, NUMEQUAL, or EQUAL

note: A tapscript k-of-n written with CHECKSIGADD. The threshold compare may be GREATERTHANOREQUAL instead of NUMEQUAL. Without the compare, the signature count itself is the result. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.
